column1: # The smoke and exhaustive rows still pin an exact depth and run under
# RAVEL_TLA_WORKERS=auto (smoke.cfg in ci.yml's required lane, exhaustive.cfg in
# tla-nightly.yml), so both can overshoot the way commit/bands.tsv's smoke.cfg
# did. #1671 tracks measuring and loosening them. positive/window-gate.cfg
# (issue #2339) pins its distinct count exactly, which is worker-independent
# under the VIEW, and waives depth with the '-' sentinel for the same reason.
